_comment: Deterministic workflow routing: (current_plugin, current_phase) -> next_plugin. Edit this to add or change routes without touching orchestrator/core.py. Each entry's next_plugin should also appear in the source plugin's INTEROP.md as a '## → <plugin>' handoff target; PluginRouter logs a warning (does not fail) if it doesn't, since INTEROP.md handoff sections don't always map 1:1 to phase-specific routes.
